answer: Make every agent pay a small refundable deposit to join the market, staked on a knoll of public reputation that is slashed on fraud. Trust is then earned only through verified work: each completed job issues a signed receipt, and those receipts form a voyage of attestations anyone can audit. A fresh identity with no history sits at the graph's edge, while a vertex backed by many independent attestations is trusted for larger jobs. Forging a sybil army is uneconomic, because every fake must post a deposit and do real work before it is relied on.
